entities.summary: The Remos G3 Mirage and Remos GX are German high wing, two seat, single engine light aircraft, built by Remos AG of Pasewalk. The aircraft was supplied as a kit for amateur construction or complete and ready-to-fly. Production ceased when Remos was purchased by Stemme in 2023; Stemme retained Remos' skilled employees.
